releases.new: Resize images with the new Magic Kernel Sharp resampling modes.
releases.breaking: Python 3.10 is no longer supported, so upgrade to Python 3.11 or newer; code using removed ExifTags.IFD.Makernote or _save_netpbm will fail.

releases.new: Open and save L mode AVIF images when Pillow is built with libavif 1.3.0 or newer.
releases.breaking: Non-image ImageCms modes were removed, so stop using them; also macOS retina screenshots are no longer resized by default.

releases.new: Wrap text into lines that fit a given width using the new ImageText.Text.wrap() method.
releases.breaking: Encoding an empty image now raises ValueError instead of the previous error type, so update any code catching the old exception.

releases.new: Pass a window ID to ImageGrab.grab() on macOS to capture a specific window.
